metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: Unexpected Process Execution from Web Directory
properties.description: Behavioral detection rules for unknown zero-day exploitation patterns
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "unexpected" or CommandLine contains "process" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-ZERO_DAY-087
